registrations.title: Registrations
registrations.subtitle: Turn vetting on per registration, check that every badge type has a workflow, and link the form questions vetting relies on.
registrations.noAccessBody: Ask a vetting administrator for the Registration vetting settings permission.

summary.vettingOnHint: {count, plural, =0 {All registrations vetted} one {{n} with vetting off} other {{n} with vetting off}}
summary.attentionHint: Uncovered badge types or no strong identifier
summary.hiddenHint: Not visible to any team yet

coverage.covered: {count, plural, one {{covered} of {n} badge type covered} other {{covered} of {n} badge types covered}}
coverage.needsChoice: {count, plural, one {{n} needs a choice} other {{n} need a choice}}
coverage.noVetting: {count, plural, one {{n} without vetting} other {{n} without vetting}}

registrations.newHidden: {count, plural, one {{n} new question hidden} other {{n} new questions hidden}}
registrations.requests: {count, plural, =0 {No requests} one {{n} request} other {{n} requests}}

empty.title: No registrations match
empty.body: Try another search or clear the filters.
empty.scopeBody: Choose another event, or All events, in the header.

registrations.footnote: Open a registration to change its vetting settings and form questions.

detail.requests: {count, plural, =0 {No vetting requests yet} one {{n} vetting request} other {{n} vetting requests}}
detail.neverUpdated: Settings unchanged since the registration was set up

save.fixFirst: {count, plural, one {Fix {n} issue to save} other {Fix {n} issues to save}}
save.stale: Someone changed these settings in another session. Load the latest version before saving.

errors.notAllowed: You no longer have permission to change these settings.
errors.stale: These settings changed in another session. Load the latest version and try again.
errors.invalid: Some settings need fixing before they can be saved.

issues.title: Before you can save
issues.noFullName: Link Full name to a form question before saving.
issues.noStrongId: Link Full name and one ID (National ID / Iqama, or Passport + Nationality) before saving.
issues.noDob: Date of birth isn't linked. List checks will be less precise.
issues.uncoveredBadge: Choose No vetting or Block for {badgeType}: it has no workflow allotted.
issues.duplicateIdField: {field} is linked to a question that already holds another identifier.
issues.blacklistOffNotAllowed: Only users with Blacklist approval can turn blacklist screening off.

status.title: Vetting
status.subtitle: When vetting is on, every new registration becomes a vetting request before a badge is issued.
status.onHint: New registrations go through the allotted workflow.
status.offHint: Off keeps the current registration and badge process.
status.note: Changes here affect only new registrations. Requests already submitted are never changed.

coverage.title: Badge type coverage
coverage.subtitle: Each request uses exactly one workflow: the one allotted to its registration and badge type.
coverage.block: Block submissions until a workflow is allotted
coverage.noVettingHint: The badge follows the normal process.
coverage.blockHint: Attendees can't submit this badge type until a workflow is allotted.

screening.title: List screening
screening.subtitle: Every new request is checked against the blacklist and watchlist before review.
screening.blacklistHint: On by default when vetting is on.
screening.blacklistLocked: Only users with Blacklist approval can turn blacklist screening off.
screening.holdHint: The request waits in Screening Hold until a compliance officer confirms or clears the match.
screening.autoRejectHint: Rejected straight away only when the National ID / Iqama or passport number matches exactly. Name matches are still held.
screening.watchlistHint: On by default. Matches are flagged for reviewers and the request carries on as normal.
screening.inactive: These settings apply once vetting is on.

message.title: Applicant message on rejection
message.subtitle: The email the attendee receives when their registration is rejected.
message.safe: Never reveals blacklist or watchlist details, or which stage rejected the registration.

bodies.tpl_reject_default:
Dear {name},

Thank you for registering for {event}. After reviewing your application, we are unable to issue a badge for this event.

If you have any questions, please contact the organising team.

Kind regards,
The {event} team
bodies.tpl_reject_brief:
Dear {name},

Your registration for {event} could not be approved.

The {event} team

mapping.title: ID fields for the list check
mapping.rule: Vetting can't be saved until Full name and one ID are linked: National ID / Iqama, or Passport number together with Nationality. Date of birth is recommended.
mapping.off: Turn vetting on in the Vetting tab to choose which questions are used in vetting and which hold identifiers.

questions.title: Form questions
questions.subtitle: Vetting uses the answers from the registration form directly. There is no separate vetting form.
questions.standardHint: Standard questions on every form. They fill the attendee profile.
questions.customHint: Questions this registration asks. Use them in team and workflow conditions.
questions.noCustom: This registration has no questions of its own yet.
questions.visibleTo: {count, plural, =0 {Hidden from every team} one {Visible to {n} team} other {Visible to {n} teams}}
questions.grantAccess: Grant access in Teams → Field access

dialog.title: Add a question
dialog.description: The question is added to the live registration form.
dialog.hiddenNote: New questions are hidden from every team until you grant access in Teams → Field access. Vetting administrators are alerted.
dialog.added: Question added. It is hidden from every team until access is granted.

history.emptyBody: Changes to vetting settings and new form questions appear here.
history.unknownQuestion: a question that no longer exists
